scripts.dev:clean: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -NoProfile -Command "$p = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($p) { foreach ($item in $p) { if ($item.State -eq 'Listen' -or $item.State -eq 'Established') { Stop-Process -Id $item.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } }; Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .next -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; next dev --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 3000"
